name: Two peaks: fitness sharing
lesson: Fitness sharing divides each individual's weight by how many neighbours it has, so a crowded hill pays for its crowd and the narrow hill keeps its share of the spins.
lookFor: Population 40, seed 23, roulette-wheel selection and a niche radius σ = 3. Without sharing (set Niching to None in the drawer and restart) this run puts 39 of the 40 individuals on the broad hill by generation 100 and never gets within ε of the narrow one; with sharing it finds the narrow hill in generation 24, where Run until stop pauses, with 6 individuals near the broad hill and 13 near the narrow one, and in generation 100 there are still 4 and 11 (the rest lie in between). Click an individual to see its niche as a ring of radius σ on the heatmap. Sharing helps but is no cure: with seeds 1 to 100 it finds the narrow hill in 51 runs against 19 for the same run without it, so 49 still miss it. A radius of σ = 2 finds it in 40 runs, and with tournaments of 2 in place of the roulette wheel sharing does not help (7 runs against 9 without it).
